item.title: IRGC spokesperson: US narrative of pilot rescue just fictional
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) spokesperson Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi has mocked Washington’s efforts to portray the alleged rescue of an American pilot in Iran as a success, saying the story recently published in the US media about the incident is “just fictional.”
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86266290/IRGC-spokesperson-US-narrative-of-pilot-rescue-just-fictional

Tehran, IRNA – Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) spokesperson Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi has mocked Washington’s efforts to portray the alleged rescue of an American pilot in Iran as a success, saying the story recently published in the US media about the incident is “just fictional.”

item.title: Iran: International engagement with Afghan officials is essential
item.description: New York, IRNA – Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations Gholamhossein Darzi stating that Tehran is closely monitoring developments in Afghanistan, pointed out that the continued international engagement with Afghan officials remains essential for advancing stability and addressing the challenges facing Afghanistan.

item.title: Iran oil facilities damaged in war on track for restoration, minister says
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad says that the reconstruction of oil industry facilities damaged during the US-Israeli-imposed war was progressing well, with part of the lost capacity expected to return by the end of the current calendar year to late March.

item.title: Kamalvandi: Protecting information on Iran’s nuclear sites is highly important
item.description: London, IRNA – Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) Behrouz Kamalvandi has stressed the importance of protecting information about Iranian nuclear facilities, including damaged sites, citing the possibility of further attacks and the International Atomic Energy Agency’s (IAEA) failure to safeguard such information.

item.title: War proved US cannot be legitimate superpower: Army
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akrami-Nia says the US-Israeli war on Iran demonstrated that the United States cannot appear as a legitimate superpower, arguing that the world is moving toward a “post-American” order.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86265890/War-proved-US-cannot-be-legitimate-superpower-Army
